## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff format src tests scripts examples` and `uv run ruff check src tests scripts examples` are clean
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes, with tests for the change (no live endpoints)
- [ ] Docs, README or CHANGELOG updated where users will notice the change
- [ ] Benchmark numbers changed? The exact commands and results are in the description, and the
      protocol is unchanged
